user.title: Monitoring mode
user.description:
**Stop by name**: every departure at a stop, all lines and directions combined.

**Stop by line and direction**: a sensor dedicated to one line and one direction, with the minutes before the next bus as its state.

**Nearby stops for a person**: the closest stops to a located entity and their next departures.

**Line status**: traffic info from grandole-mobilites.fr, delays, cancelled trips and located vehicles for one line.

**Vehicle positions**: real-time location of the buses on a line.

Open data (GTFS and GTFS-RT) is downloaded automatically, no key needed.

data_description.name: Displayed in the integrations list. Leave empty for an automatic name.

lieu.title: Stop by name
lieu.description: Pick a stop of the Grandole Mobilités network. Partial names are accepted (e.g. "gare" for Dole Gare).

liste.title: Stop by line and direction
liste.description:
Pick the stop. The next step only offers the lines serving it.

You can add several stop / line / direction combinations in the same entry.

data.add_another: Add another combination after this one

person.title: Nearby stops for a person
person.description: Select a located **person** entity. The sensor lists the stops within 1 km of their position, with their next departures.

data_description.person_entity_id: Must be a `person` entity with a GPS position.
data_description.nb_passages: Between 1 and 5 departures per line and direction at each stop.
data_description.max_stops: Limits the number of returned stops (maximum 10).

ligne.title: Line status
ligne.description: Select the line to monitor. The status combines the traffic info published on grandole-mobilites.fr (works, detours, upcoming disruptions) with real-time data: large delay, cancelled trip, skipped stop.

suivi_ligne.title: Vehicle positions
suivi_ligne.description: Select the line whose buses you want to track. GPS positions older than 5 minutes are ignored.
